snippet.title: Aethercore - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Aethercore is a third-person Action RPG set in a cyberpunk-dystopian world where immortality is for sale. Slash, dodge, parry, and use spells as you fight robotic enemies, mercenary ninjas, and undead creatures. Explore a sprawling city, take down an evil corporation, and retrieve your stolen soul.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3841070/Aethercore

Developer: Lanstrash
X: https://x.com/Lanstrash
